visibility: Internal. Not rendered anywhere in the customer-facing product.
generatedBy: gen/build.js — every derived figure is computed from the journey dataset, not typed by hand.

dataAndBrandTreatment.rule: No source brand name, company name, or source numeric figure appears in any shipped drill. Every company is fictional and every dataset is constructed.
dataAndBrandTreatment.sourcePdfStatus: PARTIALLY AVAILABLE. The source PDF itself is still not in the workspace file tree, but the extracted analytical structure of source cases 1 to 17 was supplied in the build brief, together with a mandated fictional-brand mapping. Journeys jrn-13 to jrn-24 are built against those structures: the story shape, the analytical challenge and the exhibit types follow the source, and every brand name and every figure is reconstructed. Structures for source cases 18 to 26 were truncated out of the brief and have not been built — see openWork below.
dataAndBrandTreatment.brandMapping: Every company in jrn-13 to jrn-24 comes from the brief's mandated fictional-brand list (VitaFlow, PacificBev, CleanCo, SweetVale, ActiveShield, BakePure, DairyPeak, PawJoy, Summit Gear, Ridgeline Outdoor, FrostyBite, ClearCool, TangyTaste, GreenMart). Competitor and SKU names not covered by that list were invented for this workspace (MetroMart, CityFresh, Chewmaster, LottoPop, Ricecrest, Biba, CrispBite, Northwave, Crestline, Halcyon, TopSauce, KimLee, Adabi, LadyCraft).
dataAndBrandTreatment.numericIntegrity: Every dataset in jrn-13 to jrn-24 is internally reconciled: P&L lines sum, bridges close on the stated closing value, share tables total 100%, and every figure quoted in a model answer is recomputable from its exhibit. The numericalValidation array on each drill restates the decisive arithmetic.

openWork.sourceCasesNotBuilt: Source cases 18 to 26 were cut off mid-sentence in the build brief (case 17, FreshMist packaging crisis, ends at 'Prioritize: wh'). Case 3 (PacificBev crisis management), case 8 (TechCore Systems HR recruitment), case 11 (GreenLeaf Distribution JBP recovery) and case 17 (FreshMist packaging crisis) were transmitted but not built in this pass.

chartTypeCoverage.note: The exhibit renderer (components/ExhibitRenderer.tsx) has no dedicated 'pareto' or 'slope' kind. A Pareto exhibit is built as a combo chart with bars sorted descending on the left axis and cumulative share as a right-axis line; a slope exhibit is built as a two-period multi-line chart with one line per entity, which is the shape a slope chart draws.
